description: KNa₃Mg₄F₁₂ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Pm space group. K is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.99 Å. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.67 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.75 Å. There are two inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing MgF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-28°. There are a spread of Mg-F bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.04 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing MgF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-28°. There are a spread of Mg-F bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.05 Å. There are eight inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one K, two Na, and two Mg atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one K, two Na, and two Mg atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Mg atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one K, two Na, and two Mg atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and two equivalent Mg atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and two equivalent Mg atoms. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Mg atoms. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two Na and two equivalent Mg atoms.
